newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Treasury offers A$600 mln of notes.
newsitem.headline: Australian Treasury offers A$600 mln of notes.

text.p: The Australian Treasury will offer a total of A$600 million of Treasury notes for tender on Wednesday, the Reserve Bank of Australia said.
The tender comprises A$400 million of five-week notes and A$200 million of 26-week notes.
The Treasury last week offered a total of A$1.5 billion of notes, comprising A$700 million of five-week notes, A$300 million of 13-week notes and A$500 million of 26-week notes.
There are A$752 million of non-official holdings of T-notes maturing in the week ending May 22.
